question: us-policy-positions:transportation-infrastructure.mileage-fee-replaces-fuel-tax
definition: yes = state law operates a per-mile road usage charge in which enrolled drivers pay by the mile instead of (or credited against) the fuel tax or its flat-fee substitute, in operation on 2026-01-01; no = no operating per-mile charge (pilots and studies only; flat annual EV registration fees do not count).
summarySource: ODOT OReGO page and ORS 319.885; UDOT RUC history; Va. Code § 46.2-773 (LIS); HDOT 6/30/2025 release and HRS § 249-36; Avalara 2/2025 and Utah legislative 2025 summaries listing four permanent state programs; Oregon HB 3991 (2025 special session).
